resources.string: The model stays frozen while the harness around it evolves. Each generation proposes a small change to instructions, skills, hooks or agent profiles, scores it against a fixed task suite, and waits for your approval before it becomes the baseline. Every step is readable, diffable and reversible.
None yet. The harness runs with the genome that shipped.
A run may take 3 generations and 4 candidates each, within 30 minutes and 250,000 tokens, one evaluation at a time. A genome that fails a safety probe is vetoed and cannot be promoted.
